_comment: Short excerpts from real public Google reviews of ActiveZone CDO. No reviewer names. Shown as visible text only (no review markup).

items.quote: ActiveZone feels like a second home. The environment is welcoming, comfortable, and never intimidating.
The place is huge, clean, and well-ventilated, so working out always feels comfortable.
Amazing ambiance, supportive non-judgmental and helpful gym community. Best equipment and always very clean.
